issues.on_page: GF 2500 Central services 358,664; Employee Benefit Fund 'Transfer - General Fund (as expensed from the General Fund)' 2,325 (p13); GF combining schedule Reclassifications (2,325) (p7); statement Central services 359,252 = 358,664 - 2,325 + 2,913
issues.issue: Hidden transfer: 2,325 of GF Central services was paid to the Employee Benefit Fund. detail[56] also records it as an 'other financing' transfer in, so the same money appears as both spending and a transfer. Should be split (split_from + review) into 356,339 expenditure and a -2,325 'other financing' item.

issues.on_page: Fund statement p4 and GF schedule p10 (5301): 'Insurance adjustments' 24,030; government-wide statement p2: 'Loan proceeds' 24,030
issues.issue: The report labels the same 24,030 as loan proceeds on the government-wide statement. If it really is loan proceeds it belongs in debt_proceeds, not receipts. The fund-level label looks more reliable (5400 Loan proceeds is blank).

issues.on_page: Other local receipts 258,564 = Activities receipts 243,890 (p21) + School Nutrition other receipts 14,674 (p14)
issues.issue: A mixed 'other' line, mostly student activity receipts. The category is defensible.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition Program 112,644 = Student lunches and milk 111,514 + State reimbursement 1,130 (p14)
issues.issue: Includes 1,130 of state reimbursement (state aid). Charges are dominant.
These are fines and license fees passed through by the county. 'fines and forfeitures' may fit better. The statement calls it 'County receipts'.

issues.on_page: Support services - students 682,144 = General 370,157 + Other Governmental (Activities Fund) 311,987
issues.issue: Mixed line. 46% is student activities spending.
Principal and interest aren't split. Recording it all as principal is an assumption (detail[49] does the same).
